items.title: Courtland Sutton: Remains quiet in OT win
items.body_text: Sutton brought in two of three targets for 19 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jaylen Waddle: Team-high catch total Thursday
items.body_text: Waddle secured four of seven targets for 24 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bo Nix: Season-low passing yardage in OT win
items.body_text: Nix completed 17 of 27 passes for 107 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed four times for two yards in the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday. He also recovered a fumble. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Sam Darnold: Key errors in OT loss
items.body_text: Darnold completed 27 of 51 passes for 278 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed twice for 19 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday. He also threw a two-point conversion pass. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Emanuel Wilson: Struggles with efficiency in loss
items.body_text: Wilson rushed 14 times for 52 yards and failed to bring in his only target in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
